groups.name: agent
groups.description: Execution agents, their tokens, and the jobs and workloads they run.

groups.name: changeset
groups.description: Change sets, their revisions, and the component values they propose.

groups.name: component
groups.description: The component registry, where published Terraform modules, Helm charts and manifests live.

groups.name: env
groups.description: Deployment environments and the components in them.

groups.name: run
groups.description: Runs of change sets, plan through apply.

scopes.name: agent:deploy
scopes.description: Fetch revision bundles and report revision results.

scopes.name: agent:exec
scopes.description: Agent runtime job execution — heartbeat, claim jobs, fetch job bundles, and report job results.

scopes.name: agent:read
scopes.description: Read agents, agent tokens, jobs, workloads, and workload events.

scopes.name: agent:status
scopes.description: Report agent status, workload status, and workload metrics.

scopes.name: agent:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete agents; manage agent tokens and identity bindings.

scopes.name: app:read
scopes.description: Read applications.

scopes.name: app:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete applications.

scopes.name: changeset:read
scopes.description: Read change sets, their revisions and diffs, and the values they propose.

scopes.name: changeset:write
scopes.description: Create, edit, and discard change sets.

scopes.name: component:publish
scopes.description: Publish revisions and set tags. Adds to the registry and removes nothing from it, which is what a CI publish key holds.

scopes.name: component:read
scopes.description: Read components, their revisions and tags, and the contract and findings each revision carries.

scopes.name: component:write
scopes.description: Edit a component's metadata, retire components, deprecate revisions, and delete floating tags, in addition to everything a publisher can do.

scopes.name: credential:read
scopes.description: Read credentials.

scopes.name: credential:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete credentials.

scopes.name: env:read
scopes.description: Read environments and their components.

scopes.name: env:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and delete environments.

scopes.name: run:read
scopes.description: Read runs and revisions.

scopes.name: run:write
scopes.description: Create, apply, and cancel runs; retry revisions.

scopes.name: tenant:read
scopes.description: Read the caller's own tenant -- name, slug, and status.

scopes.name: tenant:write
scopes.description: Update the caller's own tenant's settings, and close it -- suspending or deleting the tenant you own. Which of those you may actually do is decided per tenant, not by holding this.

scopes.name: token:read
scopes.description: Read your own API keys.

scopes.name: token:write
scopes.description: Create, update, and revoke your own API keys.

scopes.name: user:read
scopes.description: Read user profiles within your own tenant.

scopes.name: user:write
scopes.description: Create users and manage their access -- suspending, reactivating, or offboarding them. Reach is decided per tenant rather than by holding this, so the same scope covers adding someone to your own tenant and an operator acting across the platform.

scopes.name: var:read
scopes.description: Read resolved environment variables, including secret values.
